summary.intent: Execute Phase 20 (vault-migration) of the cipher-box project, implementing a v2 binary blob format for vaults across the core library, API, Rust desktop app, and web client, then verify the implementation through human UAT.
summary.outcome: All 4 plans executed successfully across 3 waves. Security review and simplify pass completed with 2 high issues fixed. A critical bug was discovered and fixed in fetchAndDecryptMetadata (both web and SDK) that failed to handle v2 binary blobs. Phase 20 checkpoint partially verified — migration confirmed working via DB, recovery tool bug found and fixed during UAT.

repo: The project uses a GSD (get-shit-done) workflow system with wave-based parallel agent execution, plan files, SUMMARY.md artifacts, and STATE.md tracking in .planning/
orval codegen generates `{ [key: string]: unknown } | null` instead of `string | null` for nullable string fields — `as unknown as string` casts are the correct workaround, not a code smell
NestJS does not auto-log incoming request routes, making it appear that API endpoints were never called when they actually were — confirmed by querying the database directly
The cipher-box stack runs IPFS on 192.168.133.114 with gateway on port 8080, but Kubo's delegated routing API (/routing/v1/ipns) is not exposed — only /api/v0/name/resolve on port 5001
TEE decrypts IPNS keys in hardware only, signs, and immediately discards — IPNS private keys must always be encrypted with TEE public key before transmission
The key hierarchy is rootFolderKey → folderKey → fileKey; ECIES is used for key wrapping, AES-256-GCM for content encryption

code.finding: fetchAndDecryptMetadata blindly JSON.parsed IPFS blob bytes without checking for v2 binary format — needed to strip the v2 header (detectBlobVersion + deserializeVaultBlobV2) before decryption
Same v2 blob handling bug as folder.service.ts — SDK version also needed detectBlobVersion check before JSON.parse
fetchFromIpfs returned undefined on non-404 gateway failures (502/503), causing detectBlobVersion to crash on undefined.length — needed explicit undefined guard
serialize_vault_blob_v2 had no key length bounds checking — silent u16 truncation possible for oversized keys; function changed to return Result with explicit length validation
InitVaultRequest and VaultResponse derived Debug which would expose encrypted key material in logs — replaced with custom Debug impls that redact sensitive fields
Migration IIFE called deriveVaultIpnsKeypair() twice with identical inputs — hoisted above try/catch and reused. Also had redundant destructure/re-wrap of ipnsKeypair into identical object.
Desktop vault init wrapped rootFolderKey twice with same ECIES public key — once for DB storage and once for v2 blob serialization. Fixed to reuse first wrap.

workflow: When NestJS API logs show no calls to an endpoint, query the database directly before concluding the endpoint was never hit — NestJS doesn't auto-log request routes
The GSD debug workflow (gsd:debug) spawns a fresh 200k context subagent — effective for deep investigation without polluting orchestrator context
Recovery tool testing requires extracting the vault IPNS private key; in Playwright/Vite dev mode this can be done via browser_evaluate importing the auth store directly

Public IPFS gateways (ipfs.io, delegated-ipfs.dev) may be unavailable or slow for IPNS resolution during local testing — local Kubo can resolve via /api/v0/name/resolve on port 5001 but uses a different API format than delegated routing
Playwright MCP can be used to automate login flows and capture browser console output mid-session, enabling live debugging of browser-side crypto issues

friction: API Error: Unable to connect to API (ConnectionRefused) interrupted the first security review attempt, requiring a second invocation
orval codegen generates incorrect TypeScript types for nullable string fields — investigation into fixing the DTO wasted time before discovering it's an orval bug requiring casts
NestJS not logging request routes caused significant confusion — migration appeared to never run when it had actually succeeded 12+ hours earlier
Local Kubo IPFS doesn't expose delegated routing API on the gateway port, making recovery tool IPNS resolution fail with public gateways when IPNS record wasn't in DHT
Playwright session was cleared by HMR after code changes, requiring re-login for each test iteration
OTP codes had to be manually extracted from server logs multiple times during UAT
open_items: M-1: Recovery tool private key (ipnsPrivateKey) not zeroed from memory after use
M-2: No deduplication guard on concurrent migration from multiple browser tabs — could trigger double migration race
M-3: Unnecessary ECIES re-wrap of rootFolderKey on every root folder FUSE publish — should cache wrapped key in AppState
L-1: Zero-length key accepted by v2 blob deserializers without error
L-2: No SRI hashes on CDN scripts in recovery.html
Device registry sync failing with CryptoError: Invalid registry format — pre-existing schema mismatch between current device registry format and what's stored on IPFS (todo captured)
Bin IPNS name 404 resolution failure — pre-existing issue with bin IPNS record not resolving (todo captured)
Recovery tool IPNS resolution falls back to ipfs.io public gateway which may not have the record — consider adding Kubo API fallback (/api/v0/name/resolve on port 5001) for local dev
